examples.title: Insert the node into an existing pipe
examples.code:
# Connect an existing source to input 0.
frameBlend = nuke.createNode("FrameBlend")
frameBlend.setInput(0, source)

# Configure the "blendmask" control.
frameBlend = nuke.createNode("FrameBlend")
frameBlend["blendmask"].setValue("rgba")
